scripts.features:
BARRAGE - Bee Game Reworked
Update Log & Feature List
AUTOMATED FARM, MOVEMENT, & CONVERSION
Field Traversal & Pattern Engine: Multi-pattern navigation engine with customizable field selection, positioning, field-pattern customization, and Pattern ESP. Supports automatic digging, sprinkler placement, hive claiming, follow-player routines, and character movement overrides (Teleport, Tween, Walk, Walk Speed, and Jump Power).

Token & Event Priorities: Token gathering targeting ability tokens and loot tokens with full priority controls. Includes field-mechanic priority tracking alongside automated farming for Firefly and Sprout field events.

Auto Convert & Hive Balloons: Automated conversion routines at the hive featuring configurable backpack thresholds and hive-balloon processing.

QUESTS, COMBAT, & CHALLENGE AUTOMATION
Quest & Mob Automation: Automated task execution across Story and Repeatable Quests with Auto Turn-In. Features Auto Kill and Auto Boss combat modules complete with loot collection, mob/boss failsafes, and dodge/hitbox ESP visualizers.

Challenge & Minigame Suite:

Ant Challenge: Automated arena participation with integrated dodging and token gathering.

Auto Robo Challenge: Field selection, automated combat, dodging, and specialized combat ESP.

Auto Stick Bug: Automated challenge initiation, dodging routines, and loot collection.

Auto Match: Memory match solver supporting both Legit and Blatant execution modes.

PLANTERS, BUFFS, & HIVE PROGRESSION
Planters & Buff Automation: Auto Planter featuring field/planter selection and loot harvesting. Features Auto Boost with item selection, reserve controls, refresh timing, automatic Glitter stacking, and Auto Field Boosters.

Bee Setup & Rebirth Progression: Complete hive expansion featuring Auto Hatch (with bee priority selection), Auto Royal Jelly (with target queues), Auto Mutation, Auto Feed, and Auto Hive Slot purchasing with configurable honey-reserve thresholds.
